subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard assertions are repaired, should OpenClaw accept these grouped privileged action revisions as one security-reviewed update?
rationale: The revisions execute third-party code with repository secrets and elevated permissions; CI can prove syntax and behavior but cannot decide whether the combined supply-chain boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Approve after repair and review
options.body: Repair all mirrored pins, verify each exact upstream revision and permission contract, then approve the grouped update on the refreshed head.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, Codex, container-publishing, and scanning actions into narrower PRs for isolated review and rollback.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until an owner can complete the required source and security review.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair and review
recommendation.body: Repair all mirrored pins, verify each exact upstream revision and permission contract, then approve the grouped update on the refreshed head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing candidate for the repository's CI and security-sensitive workflow surface and is already engaged with the PR.
